text.en: Non-equilibrium radiation: distinct diffusion and transport Separate Su-Olson diffusion and transport by normalization,boundaries and sources,with an additional matched periodic Fourier control for the resolved diffusion limit. These additional validation supplements are managed separately from the common 22-example registry. Receipts cover independent ZIP extraction, tests and every fixed input within each group. Changes of settings, methods or step sizes do not add independent physical problems. Routine supplement CI runs the supplement groups listed in the public registry with NumPy,SciPy and pytest. It checks versions,inputs and execution records for stored independent references and distinguishes their reuse from new reference computations. The existing common22-case suite,including quantum convergence,remains manual on explicit need; released artifacts,criteria and history are preserved. Download and execute the supplement Run inside atlas-radiation-matter-2026-11-24-r2 from the ZIP. This command executes all 2 fixed cases in the supplement. The bundled results/ contains stored outputs. Rerun into a new output/ directory, and choose another fresh directory for subsequent runs. python -m pip install -r requirements.txt python -m pytest -q python run.py --input inputs.json --output output Matplotlib is optional for redrawing saved figures; ordinary scientific execution does not require it. Su–Olson1996 non-equilibrium diffusion Advance actual radiation/material fields with the Marshak boundary and compare with independently qualified pinned ExactPack integrals. Methods, equations, figures and references Assumptions, units and boundaries Nondimensionalepsilon1,x0..16,initialu=v0,leftRobin inflow/right0;128/256/512cells plus half-step/domain24probes. Editorial clarification This1996diffusion model is distinct from1997angular transport. Original paper fulltext unread;officialsoftware selected values qualified. Direct dimensionless functions avoid ambiguous mass-opacity physical-wrapper units. Adopted numerical method Conservative FV/backwardEuler with opposite exchange sources coupled by a shared Schur complement and Robin half-cell resistance beta+h/2. Analytic nonunitepsilon.25/2controls exercise the same exchange operators. ϵuτ−uxx=v−u,vτ=u−v u(0,τ)−23ux(0,τ)=1 ϵ=4a/α,em/E0=v/ϵ,E=ϵu+v References and measured quantities The independent54check reference study is shared with transport. Five primary runs separate u/vreferenceerror,all-step capacity-weighted budgets/positivity,time and finite-domain sensitivity.
